latestPost.text: World's first trillionaire! SpaceX Starship 12th test flight launches from Starbase, Texas May 22. IPO projected at $2.2 trillion valuation. SpaceX exploring Tesla merger and xAI partnership for space-based AI datacenters.

Postponed signing AI executive order after uninviting top tech CEOs last minute — 'didn't like it.' Defends $1.8B anti-weaponization fund amid bipartisan backlash. Skipped Don Jr.'s Bahamas wedding citing 'love for the United States.'

PM Modi chairs high-level security meeting with Shah, Jaishankar, Doval, and CDS on US-Iran-Israel conflict. Big Tech CEOs commit $50 billion for India's AI and digital infrastructure. Quad Foreign Ministers meet in New Delhi May 26.

Meta cuts 8,000 jobs, reassigns 7,000+ to AI-focused roles. Plans $145B in AI data center spending this year. 'AI is the most consequential technology of our lifetimes.' Defends employee monitoring to win the AI race in leaked audio.

Gemini app hits 900 million monthly users. Google cuts AI Ultra tier to $200. Introduced Gemini 'Spark' — always-on autonomous AI agent. Says companies could save up to $1 billion annually using Gemini 2.5 Flash. Top clients processing 1 trillion tokens daily.

Microsoft expands $80 billion AI and cloud infrastructure investment as Azure surpasses $75 billion quarterly revenue. Company joins wave of AI-driven workforce restructuring, looking at voluntary retirement programs for the first time.

OpenAI barrels toward September IPO — filing paperwork with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley within weeks. Offered $2M in tokens to every YC startup. ChatGPT reaches 900M weekly active users, 50M paid subscribers. Threatens Apple with legal action.

Will step down as Apple CEO on September 1, 2026. John Ternus named successor — 'the mind of an engineer, the soul of an innovator, the heart to lead with integrity.' Cook becomes executive chairman after 15 years leading Apple to $4 trillion.

Big Tech pours $50 billion into India over 5-7 years for AI, cloud, and digital infrastructure after PM Modi meets CEOs. Fundamentum Partnership continues backing India's digital infrastructure startups. Intel also planning India investments.

Bill Gates criticizes calls for AI development pauses, argues stopping progress is counterproductive. Continues skepticism toward cryptocurrency and NFTs. Gates Foundation drives global health and disease eradication initiatives.

Nvidia Q1 revenue hits jaw-dropping $82 billion — 10x from three years ago. Demand 'gone parabolic.' Vera CPU opens $200 billion market. Upped quarterly dividend, added $80B to buyback program. Vera Rubin launching Q3. Stock lag 'mystery of the universe.'

UK PM co-chairs Paris meeting with Macron on keeping Hormuz Strait open post-Iran conflict — 40+ countries attend. Announces free summer bus travel for children across England. Navigates Peter Mandelson document fallout in Belfast.

Becomes first Australian PM to win second consecutive term in 21 years, credited with diverging from Trump's policies. Prepares for Quad Foreign Ministers meeting in New Delhi on May 26 with Indo-Pacific security focus.
New Zealand PM Christopher Luxon focuses on domestic policy reforms while maintaining engagement with Pacific and Five Eyes partners on security and trade.
UAE Vice President Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid continues driving Dubai's tech and economic transformation with focus on AI adoption, smart city initiatives, and sustainable development goals.

Italian PM hosts PM Modi for bilateral talks in Rome, strengthening India-Italy ties on trade, defense, and tech. Also meets French President Macron in Rome amid diplomatic engagements on Mediterranean security.

Co-chairs Paris meeting with UK PM Starmer on maintaining Hormuz Strait access post-Iran conflict — 40+ countries attend. Meets Italian PM Meloni in Rome. Polymarket gives 44% probability of Trump-Macron call in May.

PM Modi chairs high-level security meeting on US-Iran-Israel crisis with Shah, Jaishankar, Doval, and CDS. India to host Quad Foreign Ministers meeting May 26. Big Tech CEOs commit $50 billion for AI and digital infrastructure.

Trump postponed signing AI executive order — uninvited top tech CEOs last minute. White House launches AI.Gov website to strengthen US AI leadership. Administration invests $2 billion in quantum computing through IBM and others.
First Indian to 14,000 T20 runs. Scores 9th IPL hundred this season as RCB secure playoff spot. Handshake snub of Travis Head after RCB vs SRH goes viral — taunted Head as 'impact player.'

Mumbai Indians eliminated from IPL 2026 playoffs after another inconsistent campaign. Captain Rohit Sharma's side suffered top-order collapses. MI languish at the bottom of the table amid squad rebuild questions.

Didn't play a single game in IPL 2026 — sidelined by calf strain and thumb injury. CSK eliminated after 89-run loss to GT. 'If he knows it is not right, he won't play' says coach. IPL future uncertain at 44.
Emerges as potential MI captain after Hardik Pandya's difficult season. Sanjay Manjrekar backs Bumrah's leadership credentials. Continues to be India's premier fast bowler across formats.

Fined 10% of match fee for 'abuse of cricket equipment' — knocked bails off stumps during KKR loss. A forgettable IPL 2026: 172 runs, 4 wickets in 9 matches. Could be released ahead of IPL 2027 mini auction as MI eyes squad reset.

ICC President Jay Shah targets making women's cricket the most popular sport in the world. PCB engages ICC on visa issues preventing Pakistani players from joining IPL. T20 World Cup preparations continue.

IPL 2026 playoff race boiling point: RCB, GT, SRH through. One spot remains — PBKS, RR, KKR, DC in contention. CSK, MI, LSG eliminated. GT crush CSK by 89 runs in decisive Match 66. Season finale May 31.

Olympic champion Neeraj Chopra continues javelin season preparation ahead of major competitions. India's first individual Olympic gold medalist remains the face of Indian athletics on the global stage.
PV Sindhu, India's double Olympic medalist, continues her competitive badminton season aiming to maintain world ranking and defend her legacy ahead of upcoming international events.
Sania Mirza stays active in tennis commentary and mentoring young Indian players following her retirement from professional tennis. Continues her brand as India's greatest tennis player.

World Chess Champion faces sharp criticism from Nepomniachtchi: 'Nearly every top Grandmaster would have a good chance in a match against him.' Nepo says Gukesh's post-Candidates form has been 'disturbing for fans.'
India football legend Sunil Chhetri continues his mentoring role for the next generation of Indian footballers as the ISL 2025-26 season reaches its conclusion.

Won Ohio Republican gubernatorial primary with 82% of the vote on May 5. Will face Democrat Amy Acton in November — could become first Indian-American and Hindu governor. Endorsed by Trump with $40M+ campaign war chest.

IBM benefits from Trump's $2 billion quantum computing push. IBM CEO says new quantum foundry firm will offer chipmaking tech to outside customers. D-Wave, Rigetti also receive funding. IBM stock surges on the announcement.
Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen pushes generative AI integration across Creative Cloud and Experience Cloud amid fierce competition from Canva, Figma, and emerging AI-native design tools.
Former Twitter CEO Parag Agrawal maintains low profile post-Musk acquisition, focusing on AI ventures and advisory roles in Silicon Valley's startup ecosystem.
Chanel CEO Leena Nair leads the luxury maison through transformation, balancing traditional craftsmanship with digital innovation and sustainability goals in the evolving luxury market.
FedEx CEO announces spin-off of FedEx Freight division. AI-powered supply chain solutions and leadership changes drive the company's logistics transformation amid Amazon competition.
Former UK PM Rishi Sunak remains active in Conservative politics, focusing on trade policy and UK's post-Brexit tech strategy as the party navigates opposition under Keir Starmer's Labour government.

External Affairs Minister in PM Modi's high-level security meeting on US-Iran-Israel crisis. India to host Quad Foreign Ministers meeting in New Delhi on May 26 with bilateral meets with Australia, Japan, US counterparts.
